title: REFLECT: Role-Aware Detection of Sentiment, Emotion, Politeness, and Formality
abstract: arXiv:2610.13797v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Detecting communicative meaning in dialogue requires modeling not only lexical content but also the participant-role structures through which sentiment, emotion, politeness, and formality (SEPF) are expressed. Existing approaches rely on contextual language representations while leaving semantic roles implicit. We introduce a role-aware transformer architecture that maps the four SEPF dimensions to theory-grounded Semantic Role Labeling (SRL) configurations, incorporating these configurations directly into the transformer's self-attention mechanism. Role-aware attention models non-directional internal states (sentiment and emotion), while directional role-aware attention captures initiator-to-recipient relations for external cues (politeness and formality). translated_title: REFLECT：角色感知的情感、情绪、礼貌与正式度检测
translated_abstract: 检测对话中的交际意义，不仅需要对词汇内容进行建模，还需要对情感、情绪、礼貌与正式度（SEPF）得以表达所依赖的参与者角色结构进行建模。现有方法依赖上下文语言表示，而将语义角色保持在隐式状态。我们提出了一种角色感知的Transformer架构，将SEPF四个维度映射到基于理论的语义角色标注（SRL）配置中，并将这些配置直接融入Transformer的自注意力机制。角色感知注意力用于建模非方向性的内部状态（情感和情绪），而方向性的角色感知注意力则捕捉外部线索（礼貌和正式度）中从发起者到接受者的关系。最终得到的角色感知表示通过一个可学习的门控机制与上下文嵌入相融合，该门控机制能够自适应地权衡每个输入所贡献的角色信息量，而不是……
tldr: 本文提出角色感知的Transformer架构REFLECT，通过将语义角色标注（SRL）配置直接融入自注意力机制，并用方向性注意力建模礼貌与正式度、非方向性注意力建模情感与情绪，从而实现对对话中四种交际含义的联合检测。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces REFLECT, a role-aware transformer architecture that integrates Semantic Role Labeling (SRL) configurations into self-attention, using directional attention for politeness/formality and non-directional attention for sentiment/emotion to jointly detect these four communicative dimensions in dialogue.
